summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K disclosing a multi-year SiGe capacity partnership expansion with Semtech, not a special situation. The agreement calls for Semtech to invest in securing dedicated silicon germanium capacity across Tower fabs in the United States, Israel and Japan, supporting AI data center optical and copper interconnects from 800G and 1.6T toward 3.2T. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; no merger, tender, spin-off, activist or capital-return mechanic applies. Watch capacity-commitment disclosures and fab utilization updates as the commercial read-through.
